skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 30% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 190% ATK Direct DMG to a single target. On [Crit], if the target has no death-immunity, applies [ImmuneNotDeath] to it (disables its undying/death-prevention effect).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 190% > 240% ATK Direct DMG to a single target. Applies [ImmuneNotDeath] to the target if it has no death-immunity (on Crit > always, no [Crit] required). If the target already had death-immunity, heals self for a portion of Max HP instead.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases HP by. Removes [Stun] from himself after any character's action. After an ally acts, launches an [Ultimate Follow-up] on 1 random enemy in the [Ignore DMG] state, up to 2 times per round.[Ultimate Follow-up]: deals 50% of the Ultimate skill's DMG (same effects).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Ultimate Follow-up] DMG 50% > 60% (still up to 2 times per round).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Ultimate Follow-up] DMG 60% > 70% (still up to 2 times per round).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of match, Garou obtains 2x unyielding effect based on 50% MAX HP. Once unyielding effect is reduced, Garou activates specialised protection effect (120% of MAX HP, removes damage, stackable with extra HP effects, remove damage will not be 5x of original HP).

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Once allies under unyielding/special unyielding condition is expired, Garou obtains 100% of own MAX HP specialised protection, max 3 times per match.

effects.desc: Đòn chí mạng gây thêm sát thương; Some units may be immune to [Crit].
Mark a unit, unlocking a raid condition or bonus effect associated with the mark.
Unfavorable effects negate the target's invincibility/anti-death effects, allowing it to be knocked down as normal.
Removes existing effects/buffs on all enemies.
